evaluatedCandidates.reason: The current official geoservice page publishes the endpoint but not sufficient imagery provenance and licensing for STRACKER; historical official Argenmap documentation identifies Google imagery.
IGN publishes public aerial orthomosaics, but coverage, capture date, resolution and a stable layer covering the full Santa Fe product area are not guaranteed as one complete basemap.

The live WMTS catalog identifies the 2016 Web Mercator layer as s2cloudless_3857. It is a global land mosaic with no API key, CC BY 4.0 and no billing dependency; lower 10 m resolution and historical 2016-2017 imagery are disclosed.
